concerns.text: FR-008 and US-4 explicitly require generating a 'Prompt-Based Cohort' of synthetic code to validate causal claims. The tasks (T014b-NEW, T033a, T034) replace this with a 'Classifier-Based Proxy' on real code. While the Plan documents this as a contradiction, the tasks do not implement the specific FR-008 requirement (generation from scratch) or the US-4 validation step. This leaves the primary research question (impact of *generated* code) unaddress by the implementation plan.

FR-004 mandates propensity score matching on 'semantic similarity' as a covariate. Tasks T017b and T022 explicitly exclude semantic similarity from the matching algorithm to avoid collider bias. No task exists to implement the matching logic required by FR-004 (including semantic similarity) or to formally document the waiver of this specific requirement in the code execution flow.

FR-002 mandates generating synthetic code snippets with a generation time ≤ 30 seconds per snippet. The tasks (T014b-NEW) replace this generation step with classification of existing code. No task exists to implement the generation logic or to enforce the 30-second performance constraint, rendering the requirement moot without a formal scope change.

SC-007 requires the prompt-based cohort to have ≥95% syntactic validity. Since the tasks abandon the generation of a prompt-based cohort entirely in favor of classifying real code, there is no task or artifact that can possibly measure or satisfy this success criterion.

US-4 requires a 'Prompt-Based Generation Cohort Validation' to isolate the effect of 'LLM generation from scratch'. Task T033a only performs a descriptive comparison of 'LLM-like' (classified) vs. 'Human' code. This fails to implement the specific 'generation from scratch' validation required by the user story.

Task T014b-DOC states it will 'Flag for Spec Update' but does not implement the actual spec update or the formal waiver process required by the Constitution (FR-030) for deviating from FR-008/FR-002. The task description implies a documentation step but lacks the concrete action to resolve the spec contradiction.
